# Setting up the nsave app on a new phone


nsave team


Dec 30, 2025


You can move your nsave account to a replacement phone without changing your account details or balances.


## Before changing devices


- Keep your existing phone signed in until the new device is ready.
- Confirm that you can receive messages on your registered number.
- Install the latest version of the nsave app.


## Sign in on the new phone


### If you cannot use the old phone


Choose the recovery option during sign-in. For security, support may ask you to repeat part of the identity check before the new device becomes trusted.
